policy: Reviewed Strong's inflection/paradigm groups for dictionary-form study. These are not etymology groups: unrelated derived words remain separate. Original entries and per-ID counts are retained for hard mode. Greek dictionary verb headwords can conventionally be first-person singular; no uninflected stems are invented.
basis: OpenScriptures Greek Word List entries, their src links, and the corresponding Strong's inflection families. Explicit reviewed mappings avoid assuming that src (which can encode etymology) always identifies a lemma. Plural you (G5210) remains its own dictionary headword; adverbs and derived possessive adjectives are not folded into their source pronouns.
